name: Opsgenie
description: Opsgenie is Atlassian's retiring alerting, on-call, and incident-response product. Existing customers can continue operating their current sites during the migration window, but new sales ended in 2025 and Atlassian will shut the service down on April 5, 2027.
agentUseSummary: Opsgenie cannot be newly connected or installed in Relay. Atlassian has ended new sales and directs every remaining customer to migrate alerting and on-call operations to Jira Service Management or Compass before the April 5, 2027 shutdown.

blocked.label: Connect Opsgenie
blocked.description: Relay does not create new connections to a product that is closed to new sales and scheduled for shutdown.

blocked.label: Use legacy Opsgenie API
blocked.description: Relay does not request or mount legacy GenieKey access for a retiring standalone product.

blocked.label: Change Opsgenie
blocked.description: Alert, incident, on-call, schedule, team, integration, and configuration operations are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled for a retiring provider that Relay does not newly connect.

No Opsgenie tools or credentials are mounted; migrate the workflow to Jira Service Management or Compass.

providerSetup.blocker: Opsgenie ended new sales on June 4, 2025 and will be shut down on April 5, 2027. Existing customers retain temporary access only to complete migration; Relay will not create a new credential or runtime surface for the retiring standalone product.
providerSetup.nextAction: Use the Opsgenie owner migration guide to move alerts, on-call configuration, schedules, integrations, and incident workflows to Jira Service Management or Compass before April 5, 2027, then connect that destination through its separate current provider contract.

evidence.supports: Atlassian states that Opsgenie sales ended June 4, 2025, existing customers may continue only until April 5, 2027, and the service and unmigrated data will then be shut down and deleted.
New Opsgenie purchases and sign-ups are unavailable, renewals must end before shutdown, and customers are directed to Jira Service Management or Compass.
Atlassian documents replacement and deprecation of Opsgenie features and requires REST endpoints and integrations to move to Jira Service Management.
The remaining standalone API is a US/EU GenieKey API for existing sites rather than a supported new multi-customer Relay OAuth product.
